E0991

Teaching: the old `copy` keyword → `~` sigil (D-SHAPE-COPY1=A, supersedes D-CAP2/S4)

What

Teaching: the old `copy` keyword → `~` sigil (D-SHAPE-COPY1=A, supersedes D-CAP2/S4)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0991

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0991: tests/ui/copy_keyword_retired_e0991.stderr.

Error [E0991]: `copy` is now the `~` sigil
  --> tests/ui/copy_keyword_retired_e0991.jet:3:14
    |
  3 |     saved :: copy name
    |              ^^^^
 Why: Jet has exactly one spelling for a copy — the `~` sigil (D-SHAPE-COPY1) — so all code reads the same
 Fix: write `~name` in place of `copy name`
